% Tier 3: Complex — matrices, cases, deep nesting
The matrix is
$$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$
with the piecewise function
$$f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } x > 0 \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$
and nested fractions $\frac{\frac{a}{b}}{\frac{c}{d}}$.
The gradient is $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} + \nabla g$.
